item.title: Wikidata Biography Enhancement / Creation
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | Several existing biography entries on Wikidata need fresh, properly sourced content so they remain accurate and complete over time. The immediate priority is adding new information, specifically: • Personal details (e.g., verified dates and places of birth, education, family background where publicly documented).
I will supply preliminary references; you will vet them against reliable sources, format the data to Wikidata standards (statements, qualifiers, references), and submit clean edits that stick. After the first round of updates, an ongoing maintenance rhythm is required so future milestones and corrections can be handled quickly without triggering notability or citation flags.
Strong familiarity with Wikidata policies, property usage, and SPARQL is essential because I want each change to integrate seamlessly with existing items and related entities. Please outline your method for sourcing, your typical turnaround for live edits, and any past Wikidata biography work when you apply.

item.title: ASAP Multi-Channel Appointment Scheduler
item.description:
5-10 GBP/hr | I need an experienced communicator who can jump in right away to handle every step of my appointment-setting flow. You will be:
• Placing and answering phone calls, • Responding promptly to incoming emails, and • Sending concise, courteous text messages.
All three channels work together toward a single goal—getting prospects and clients onto my calendar, confirming the time, and updating them if anything changes. You’ll follow my simple script guidelines, log each contact in the shared calendar or CRM, and flag me instantly whenever a conversation requires my direct input.
Quick turnaround is essential; messages can’t sit unanswered. If you’re comfortable juggling calls, email, and SMS back-to-back and can start almost immediately, let’s talk about the details and get the process rolling today.

item.title: E-Commerce Site, $4k Budget
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to invest roughly US $4,000 in building a polished e-commerce website for my brand, Rakib. The goal is a fully responsive store that’s easy for my team to manage yet robust enough to handle future growth.
Scope • Design a modern, mobile-first storefront that reflects the Rakib brand. • Set up product catalogue, secure checkout, multiple payment gateways (major cards, PayPal), and basic shipping rules. • Integrate essential features such as inventory management, order tracking, promotional codes, newsletter signup, and Google Analytics. • Configure on-page SEO fundamentals and ensure page-load times stay under three seconds on mobile and desktop. • Provide admin credentials, deployment documentation, and a brief hand-off session so we can manage products and content ourselves.
Milestones Feel free to suggest your own split, but I’m thinking something like: 25 % UI/UX & wireframes → 40 % core development → 25 % testing & refinements → 10 % launch and post-launch support.
Tech Stack Flexibility I’m open to Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, or a custom solution—as long as it stays within budget and offers an intuitive admin panel. Let me know which platform you recommend and why.
Acceptance Criteria • Live, secure site on my domain with SSL enabled • Seamless checkout flow tested end-to-end • Responsive layout confirmed across major browsers/devices • Clear documentation and recorded walk-through for future edits
In your proposal, outline the platform you’d use, timeline, and how you’ll allocate each milestone against the total budget. Let’s build something that converts visitors into loyal customers.

item.title: Custom WordPress E-Commerce Store Build
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I need a fully functional WordPress e-commerce store built from the ground up. The site will revolve around a completely custom-designed theme rather than an off-the-shelf template, so strong front-end skills and an eye for clean, conversion-focused design are essential.
The store must accept credit and debit card payments seamlessly. If you normally work with WooCommerce, Stripe, or similar gateways, feel free to recommend the most stable, PCI-compliant option—you’ll handle the setup, configuration, and end-to-end testing so that checkout runs smoothly on launch day.
Key deliverables • Bespoke WordPress theme: responsive, fast-loading, and easy for me to update • Product catalogue and shopping-cart setup, including variations and stock control • Secure credit/debit card gateway integration with test transactions completed • Core pages (home, shop, product, cart, checkout, account) styled to match the new design • Basic on-page SEO structure and performance optimisation • Handover guide showing how to add products, run promotions, and process orders
I will supply all branding assets, product photos, and copy. You’ll provide staging links throughout development so I can review progress and give feedback. Once everything meets the agreed acceptance criteria, we move the site to my live server.
If this fits your skill set and timeline, let’s get started.

item.title: WordPress Expert Person Need
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I need an experienced WordPress technician to become the steady pair of hands behind my site. Your first responsibility is ongoing upkeep: applying content, theme, and security updates promptly, testing them on a staging environment, and then rolling them out live with zero visible disruption.
Whenever a new requirement pops up I prefer a purpose-built solution, so you should be comfortable planning and coding clean, lightweight custom plugins that follow WordPress coding standards and play nicely with existing themes and core updates.
You will: • Schedule and apply content, theme, and security updates • Monitor performance and spot issues before they surface to visitors • Design, develop, and document bespoke plugins as new features are requested • Keep backups, error logs, and version control (Git) in order for quick roll-backs
Please share examples of past maintenance work as well as at least one plugin you’ve built from scratch. I’m open to setting up either a one-off scope or an ongoing retainer—let me know which you prefer and how you would structure milestones.

item.title: Ongoing WordPress Site Maintenance
item.description:
15-25 AUD/hr | I need a reliable WordPress professional to keep my site running smoothly over the long term. Your main focus will be routine plugin updates and day-to-day content edits; I’ll simply reach out whenever a change is needed, rather than on a fixed weekly or monthly schedule.
There are no unusual plugins or custom content systems to worry about—just standard WordPress, so you should be comfortable working inside the normal dashboard, running safe backups, and testing updates on a staging copy before pushing live. Solid attention to uptime, page-speed, and basic security hygiene is important to me even though I’m not asking for a full security-monitoring package right now.
Deliverables I’ll be looking for: • Timely plugin updates applied without breaking existing functionality • Content tweaks (text, images, minor layout) turned around promptly on request • A quick note or brief changelog each time you’ve completed work so I can track what’s been done
If you have a dependable workflow for safe updates and can be responsive when tasks pop up, let’s get started.

item.title: AI Platform for Distressed Deals
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to invest in a custom AI-driven platform that takes a distressed real-estate lead from raw data all the way through a signed purchase agreement—always targeting properties in pre-foreclosure, tax delinquency, or other high-motivation situations so we can acquire them well below market value.
Core capabilities I need • Data ingestion and enrichment: pull fresh owner and property details from public records, mainstream real-estate databases, and any relevant third-party APIs. The system must de-duplicate records, flag high-priority leads, and keep the data refreshed automatically. • Predictive identification: use machine-learning models to score which owners are most likely to accept a discounted cash offer. Transparency on the factors driving each score is important so I can tweak my acquisition criteria. • Multi-channel outreach: once a lead is approved, the platform should launch pre-configured SMS, e-mail, ringless voicemail, and postcard campaigns, then track every touchpoint in one timeline. • Conversation automation: integrate a GPT-style conversational agent that can handle routine seller questions and book calls into my calendar while handing complex threads off to me or my acquisitions manager. • Negotiation & contract workflow: auto-populate offer numbers, generate state-specific purchase agreements, route them for e-signature, and store everything in a secure deal folder. • Deal pipeline dashboard: Kanban or similar view showing lead → offer → under contract → closed, with projected profit and time to close calculations. • Mobile first: a companion app for both iOS and Android so I can review comps, fire off messages, or sign docs on the go.
Acceptance criteria 1. End-to-end demo that starts with raw data import and finishes with a signed test contract. 2. Accuracy metrics for lead scoring and outreach delivery provided in a written report. 3. Source code, model notebooks, and setup scripts delivered in a private repository with clear README. 4. Deployment documents for both cloud hosting and App Store / Play Store submission.
If you have prior experience mingling AI, prop-tech data feeds, and transactional workflows, let’s talk about milestones and timelines—I’m ready to move quickly.

item.title: Comprehensive WordPress Site Overhaul
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | My WordPress site needs a full, end-to-end refresh. I want the layout modernised, pages loading noticeably faster, and every plugin, theme and core file kept fully patched so security is never an after-thought. Above all, I’m aiming to elevate functionality—anything that streamlines the user journey or adds smart features is on the table.
Here’s what I expect you to handle:
• Design & layout – refine the theme, adjust templates, and polish the UI/UX so the site looks clean on all devices. • Performance & speed – implement caching, image optimisation, code minification and database cleanup to achieve sub-2-second loads and a 90+ score on Google PageSpeed Insights. • Security & updates – harden WordPress with best-practice measures (firewalls, brute-force protection, secure login), audit existing plugins, remove bloat, and set up automated, version-controlled updates.
I’m comfortable with widely used optimisation and security tools such as WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, Sucuri, Wordfence, Elementor, Advanced Custom Fields—pick what best suits the job. Custom PHP or JavaScript tweaks are welcome where plugins fall short.
Deliverables are complete once the refreshed site is live on my hosting, fully tested across desktop and mobile, and I receive a short hand-off document outlining the changes, settings, and any future maintenance steps.
If you have a proven track record of turning slow, dated WordPress installs into fast, secure, feature-rich sites, I’d love to see examples and jump right in.

item.title: Business WordPress Site
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to launch a new WordPress-based business website that showcases our products and lets customers buy with ease. The core of the build is a dedicated product section that must include:
• a clean, searchable product catalog • a fully functional shopping cart for fast checkout • visible product reviews so visitors see real feedback
WooCommerce (or an equally robust plugin) is the natural fit here, but if you have a better tool chain in mind, tell me why and how it improves speed or security. I already have hosting and a fresh WordPress install waiting; your job is to configure everything, choose or tweak a responsive theme so the shop looks polished on mobile and desktop, and make sure the catalog, cart, and review features work smoothly end-to-end.
Once finished, I’ll need a brief hand-off guide or video so my team can add new items and moderate reviews without digging into code.
Let me know the theme or stack you propose, any premium plugins you’d recommend, and a realistic timeline for first draft, revisions, and final hand-over.

item.title: Enhance AI-Powered Real Estate SaaS
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | Full-Stack AI Developer for Real Estate SaaS Platform — Long-Term Opportunity
Hourly Budget: $10/hour
Project Overview
I am developing an AI-powered real estate Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) platform that helps real estate professionals evaluate properties, identify comparable sales, and generate data-driven property valuations.
The application is already built and functional. I am looking for a developer who can review the existing codebase, improve the valuation engine, and help me develop the platform further.
I am interested in building a long-term relationship with the right person, starting with a small paid project.
Initial Paid Project
The first assignment is a technical review of the existing application.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Review the existing frontend, backend, database, and application architecture. - Evaluate property data integrations and comparable-sale selection logic. - Assess the deterministic valuation engine and identify weaknesses. - Review the OpenAI integration and ensure AI-generated explanations cannot change the final calculated values or selected comparable sales. - Identify the three most important technical issues or improvement opportunities. - Provide a prioritized development plan with estimated hours and costs.
The initial assignment is for assessment and recommendations. Do not modify or deploy changes to the production application without approval.
Required Skills
- Full-stack web application development. - Python and/or Node.js/TypeScript. - React or Next.js. - PostgreSQL or other relational databases. - REST APIs and third-party data integrations. - OpenAI API and structured AI outputs. - Git and GitHub. - Statistical analysis, regression, or data-driven valuation models.
Experience with real estate technology, property data, comparable-sale analysis, or automated valuation models is a strong advantage.
Experience with Replit-built applications is helpful.
Budget and Long-Term Opportunity
My budget is $10 per hour. I will pay for the initial assignment and subsequent approved work at the agreed hourly rate.
Please propose a focused initial assessment that fits this budget. Before starting, provide an estimate of the hours required and the deliverables.
If we work well together, I am interested in continuing with a reliable developer who can help improve and expand the platform over time.
There may be an opportunity to discuss equity in the future under a separate written agreement. Equity is not guaranteed and is not a substitute for the agreed payment for the initial work.
How to Apply
Please answer these questions:
1. What full-stack SaaS applications have you built? 2. What experience do you have with OpenAI APIs and AI-powered applications? 3. Have you worked with property data, comparable-sale selection, regression, or valuation algorithms? 4. What is your experience with Python, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, and GitHub? 5. Have you worked with applications built using Replit? 6. How many hours per week are you available? 7. How would you approach a technical assessment of this application within a limited budget? 8. Are you interested in a potential long-term collaboration?
Please include links to relevant projects or your GitHub profile.
I value practical problem-solving, honest communication, and clean, maintainable code. I am looking for someone who can understand an existing product, identify its weaknesses, and help make it more reliable and scalable.

item.title: Creative Consulting Agency Website
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to launch a fresh, creative-looking Wix site that introduces me and my consulting agency, walks visitors through three distinct service branches, and doubles as a small digital storefront.
Here’s the experience I have in mind: • A dynamic home page that quickly tells my story and links clearly to each service branch. • Three dedicated pages (or tabs) – one per branch – each with its own copy, imagery, and call-to-action. • An e-commerce section where clients can buy self-paced video courses, live or recorded webinars, and book 1-to-1 Zoom/Google Meet sessions. I need Credit/Debit card, PayPal, and Bank Transfer options running smoothly through Wix’s checkout. • A topic-specific blog I can update myself. • A resources area laid out like an alphabetical dictionary so visitors can jump straight to the term they need. • A flexible contact form with an open text field so prospects can describe their situation in detail. • A spotlight section to showcase upcoming speaking gigs and conference appearances, with room for images, dates, and links.
The overall vibe must stay creative and modern—from typography to color palette—while still making navigation effortless on both desktop and mobile. I’ll supply brand content and initial copy; you handle design, Wix setup, basic SEO, and a short hand-off guide so I can maintain everything moving forward.
Additional Requirements: • Secure hosting for training videos with restricted access to prevent unauthorized sharing. • Integration of paywalls or password protection for video access. • Capability to upload small clips for promotional use on Instagram or TikTok.

item.title: WordPress News Website Build
item.description:
50+ AUD/hr | I’m launching “The Australian Public Ledger,” a fully-fledged online news publication, and I need a skilled developer to turn the concept into a polished WordPress site.
Platform & Theme WordPress is my chosen CMS. I haven’t committed to a theme yet, so I’ll rely on your advice: suggest and implement a modern news or magazine theme (premium or custom-built child theme) that is lightweight, responsive, and easy to extend.
Core Functionality The site must feel like a professional newsroom. Beyond the usual article and category structure, I specifically need robust search, an engaging comment section, and a newsletter subscription flow that can connect to Mailchimp, Sendinblue, or similar services. Clean code, fast load times, and SEO-friendly markup are essential from day one.
Deliverables • Deploy WordPress on my hosting, configure security and performance basics. • Recommend and install an appropriate theme, then tailor branding, colours, and typography to match “The Australian Public Ledger.” • Implement: – Site-wide search with clear filtering options – Native or plugin-based comments (with moderation tools enabled) – Newsletter opt-in (popup or inline) with double-opt-in compliance • Set up core plugins only (SEO, caching, backups) to keep bloat low. • Provide a brief handover guide so editorial staff can publish confidently.
If you have a portfolio of news, magazine, or high-traffic WordPress sites, I’d love to see it alongside your proposal.

item.title: Finish Simple Website Redesign
item.description:
15-25 AUD/hr | I already have a basic site live, the layout is set and Afterpay is connected, but the last developer left several simple tasks unfinished. I need these wrapped up quickly so the site finally looks and behaves the way it should.
What still needs doing • Upload the new product and banner pictures my team will supply (all files are ready to go). • Build a clean, manual slideshow with left-right navigation buttons; no auto-play. • Proof-read every page and fix the spelling mistakes that crept in. • Add in the dksm code so that the domain email is not blocked by outgoing. • Add a lightweight contact form that sends submissions to my business email. • Place visible social-media icons (Facebook & Instagram) in the header or footer and link them to our accounts.
Technical environment The site is a straightforward HTML/CSS build with a dash of JavaScript; no heavy CMS. I can give you FTP and hosting-panel access immediately. You’re free to use vanilla JS or a small library such as Swiper or Slick for the slideshow, as long as it stays fast and responsive on mobile.
Acceptance criteria 1. All supplied images display at the correct resolution with alt text added. 2. Slideshow works on desktop and mobile, loads in under one second, and allows swipe on touch devices. 3. Zero spelling errors across all pages (I’ll run Grammarly as a double-check). 4. Contact form delivers messages reliably and shows a clear success notification. 5. Social-media icons open the correct profiles in a new tab.
Timing This is a small polish job—ideally completed within two days of access.
Important I’m hiring an independent freelancer only; agency representatives will be declined without review.
If you’re confident you can tick off everything above in the time frame, send a brief note outlining how you’ll handle the slideshow and form. Access details will follow once we agree.

item.title: UK SEO Recovery Consultant
item.description:
18-36 GBP/hr | My site was hit hard after the 20 August Google update. There was no manual penalty, but the loss in organic visibility is significant and, despite multiple fixes, rankings have not bounced back. I’m now bringing in a fresh pair of expert eyes from inside the UK to work side-by-side with my in-house SEO.
Scope • Complete audit spanning on-page, off-page and technical SEO. • Deep-dive into the keyword set we already track (list supplied). • Evaluation of prior changes so we don’t undo improvements that do work. • Action-ready recommendations for both front-end content and back-end code.
Current toolkit Google Analytics and SEMrush are connected; you’re welcome to suggest or plug in anything else you rely on, as long as access is straightforward.
Deliverables 1. Written audit report outlining issues, impact, and priority. 2. Detailed action plan categorised by quick wins, mid-term tasks, and longer-term projects. 3. Live walkthrough call with my SEO so we’re clear on implementation. 4. Two follow-up check-ins (spread over the next eight weeks) to gauge progress and tweak strategy.
Acceptance criteria • Audit highlights root causes linked to the August update rather than generic advice. • Recommendations are actionable within our current tech stack (WordPress + custom PHP). • Early wins demonstrably lift key pages back toward their previous average positions.
If you have a track record of recovering sites after core updates, let’s talk and map out the road back to our pre-update performance.
